module_catalog.name: Introduction to anatomy 151
module_catalog.content: A systematic approach to Anatomy, including general terminology, embryology and osteology, with the use of wet specimens. Introductory histology includes cytology, the nucleus and cell division, epithelial tissue, general connective tissue, cartilage and bone.
module_catalog.contact_time: 3 lectures per week, 1 practical per week, 1 discussion class per week

module_catalog.name: Anatomy of the limbs 152
module_catalog.content: Anatomy of the appendicular skeleton A systematic approach to the Anatomy of the muscles, blood vessels, nerve supply, lymph drainage and joints of the upper and lower limbs, as well as surface anatomy, with the use of wet specimens. Introductory histology includes muscle tissue, nerve tissue, and blood and haemopoietic tissue.
module_catalog.contact_time: 3 lectures per week, 1 practical per week, 1 discussion class per week

module_catalog.name: Anatomy of the torso 161
module_catalog.content: A systematic approach to the anatomy of the thorax and its contents, the abdomen and its contents and the pelvis and its contents (organs, vascular systems, nerve supply, lymph drainage, muscles and joints), as well as surface anatomy, with the use of wet specimens. Introductory histology includes the histology of the lungs, liver and kidneys.
module_catalog.contact_time: 3 lectures per week, 1 practical per week, 1 discussion class per week

module_catalog.name: Anatomy of the head and neck  162
module_catalog.content: Anatomy of the head and neck, and neuroanatomy A systematic approach to the anatomy of the head and neck regions, the senses and the central and peripheral nervous system (cranial nerves, autonomic nervous system), as well as surface anatomy, with the use of wet specimens.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1 discussion class per week, 3 lectures per week, 1 practical per week

module_catalog.name: Academic English for Health Sciences 122

module_catalog.contact_time: 1 discussion class per week, 2 lectures per week

module_catalog.name: Physiology 161

module_catalog.name: Physiology 162

module_catalog.name: Integrated healthcare leadership 120

module_catalog.name: Medical terminology 180
module_catalog.content: The acquisition of a basic medical orientated vocabulary compiled from Latin and Greek stem forms combined with prefixes and suffixes derived from those languages. The manner in which the meanings of medical terms can be determined by analysing the terms into their recognisable meaningful constituent parts, is taught and exercised. The functional use of medical terms in context as practical outcome of terminological application is continually attended to.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Health Sciences Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences Faculty of Veterinary Science

module_catalog.name: Nursing practice education 110

module_catalog.name: Nursing practice education 120

module_catalog.contact_time: 11 practical hours per week

module_catalog.name: Nursing studies 110
module_catalog.content: Introduction to nursing theory, including theoretical foundations of nursing practice, health promotion and disease prevention, as well as basic human needs.

module_catalog.name: Nursing studies 120

module_catalog.name: Physiology 251
module_catalog.content: Structure, gas exchange and secretory functions of the lungs; structure, excretory and non-urinary functions of the kidneys, acid-base balance, and skin and body temperature control. Practical work to complement the theory.

module_catalog.name: Medical microbiology 252
module_catalog.content: Infection, immunity and basic bacteriology. Introduction and basic principles of infection, sterilisation and the immune system. Bacterial cells and the classification of disease-causing bacteria.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week

module_catalog.name: Medical microbiology 253

module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week

module_catalog.name: Medical microbiology 254
module_catalog.content: Fungi, parasitology and virology. Commonly occurring fungal, viral and parasite infections and infestations, and the organisms that cause them.

module_catalog.name: Nursing studies 210

module_catalog.name: Nursing studies 220

module_catalog.name: Psychology 110
module_catalog.content: The module introduces students to psychology via an overview of the historical context of the discipline. We also introduce students to abnormal behaviour, treatments and the influence of culture on abnormal behaviour. Furthermore, students will be introduced to research in psychology, conditioning, emotion, motivation, and personality theories. Students will understand the evolution of psychology as a discipline and the general approach to research in psychology. They will better understand selected categories of psychological disorders and potential treatments used by registered psychologists.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Engineering, Built Environment and Information Technology Faculty of Education Faculty of Health Sciences Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences

module_catalog.name: Psychology 120
module_catalog.content: The module addresses key concepts and terminology related to biological psychology and cognitive psychology. Students are introduced to a basic understanding of the biological basis of human behaviour and cognitive processes. Content on the biological underpinning of emotions, behaviour and mental processes is explored in addition to understanding the physical structure and functioning of the human brain. Cognitive functions, including attention, perception, memory, language and intelligence, form the basic building blocks of human cognition. In-depth knowledge of how the brain is attuned to filtering information from the environment and how we make sense of the world around us are also studied.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Engineering, Built Environment and Information Technology Faculty of Education Faculty of Health Sciences Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences
